nodes.label: Ranger Reference Sprite Sheet
nodes.description: Third-party asset-pack sprite sheet used as reference. Layout: 4 rows on a white/transparent background, roughly 5-7 frames per row. Rows 1 and 3 mix front-facing frames with back-facing frames (hood and slung quiver visible from behind), row 2 is a side-facing walk cycle, row 4 is the bow attack sequence (draw, nock, full pull, release with arrow in flight). Archetype: hooded green-cloaked archer/ranger with face wrap, brown leather armor, back quiver and recurve bow. Art style: coarser, lower-resolution pixel art than the knight sheets, flatter shading, muted earth palette.
nodes.rationale: Reference for the ranged-attack row specifically: how many key poses a bow shot needs and where the projectile first appears.

nodes.label: Ranger Archetype (hooded archer)
nodes.description: Ranged physical class: light leather armor, hood and mask concealing the face, bow drawn across the body, arrows visible in a back quiver.

nodes.label: Attack Action Row Convention
nodes.description: The bottom row of each reference sheet holds attack key poses rather than a loop: wind-up, peak (with a drawn motion arc or emitted projectile/VFX), and recovery. Melee sheets show a slash trail, ranged/caster sheets show the projectile or spell particles.
